samples.description:
Common yellow lichen Xanthoria parietina on a branch of an ash (Fraxinus excelsior) in Frankfurt near the river Main (Germany). Lichens are interesting life forms: fungi hold algae captive in a way, that their relationship is in-between a symbiosis and purely parasitic, also described as controlled parasitism.
